title: ‘The Kids Are Casualties in a War’

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日简报栏目 DealBook 的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场，采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些坦诚、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上对精选采访进行直播，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻报道一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is A Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日播客》。

sentences.en: Over the past week, as Omicron infections surged, a high-stakes battle has played out in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 在过去的一周里，随着奥密克戎感染病例激增，芝加哥上演了一场高风险的博弈。

sentences.en: Again, between the city's mayor and its teachers' union, about whether it's safe or practical to keep schools open.
sentences.zh: 再次在芝加哥市长与教师工会之间展开，焦点是保持学校开放是否安全或切实可行。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: My colleagues Claire Tennesketter and Rob Sipko spoke with the students, teachers, and parents caught in the middle of the standoff.
sentences.zh: 我的同事克莱尔·特内斯凯特和罗布·西普科与身处这场对峙漩涡中心的学生、教师和家长进行了交谈。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, January 13th.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月13日，星期四。

sentences.en: Hi, Sonia.
sentences.zh: 嗨，索尼娅。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Hi, can you hear me?
sentences.zh: 嗨，能听到我说话吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 可以。

sentences.en: So, I would love to just start by, like, getting to know you a little bit.
sentences.zh: 所以，我只想从稍微了解你一下开始。

sentences.en: Just introduce yourself for me.
sentences.zh: 请简单自我介绍一下吧。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: My name is Sonia Johnson.
sentences.zh: 我叫索尼娅·约翰逊。

sentences.en: I'm a special ed teacher.
sentences.zh: 我是一名特教老师。

sentences.en: I've been teaching in Chicago public schools for 21 years, and I've been teaching in a high school for about 15 years.
sentences.zh: 我在芝加哥公立学校教书21年了，在高中教书大约15年了。

sentences.en: What has that been like in the recent past?
sentences.zh: 最近这段时间情况怎么样？

sentences.en: So, winter break, you know, COVID surges, infection rates just climb.
sentences.zh: 寒假期间，你知道的，新冠疫情激增，感染率一直在上升。

sentences.en: You know, we were constantly watching the news and wondering, you know, if we were going to go remote, which we all were hoping we would go remote for safety reasons.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们一直在看新闻，心里琢磨着，我们是不是要转为远程上课，为了安全起见，其实我们都希望能转为远程教学。

sentences.en: But we came back Monday, and, you know, classes were about 50% full due to COVID outbreaks.
sentences.zh: 但我们周一回来后，你知道的，由于疫情暴发，班级出勤率只有大约50%。

sentences.en: Our principal had COVID.
sentences.zh: 我们的校长感染了新冠。

sentences.en: She was out.
sentences.zh: 她请假了。

sentences.en: Our dean, he also has COVID and was out.
sentences.zh: 我们的教导主任也感染了新冠，请假了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Serious just staffing issues.
sentences.zh: 人员配置确实出现了严重问题。

sentences.en: Teachers were asked to cover for other teachers who were absent, which I did, missing my prep periods and my lunch period.
sentences.zh: 学校要求老师去代课，顶替缺勤的其他老师，我也这么做了，结果错过了我的备课时间和午休时间。

sentences.en: I had a student in my class with all the symptoms of COVID, and she said, Ms. Johnson, you know, I feel really, really sick.
sentences.zh: 我班上有个学生出现了新冠的所有症状，她说，约翰逊老师，你知道的，我感觉真的、真的很难受。

sentences.en: You know, I have a sore throat.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我喉咙痛。

sentences.en: I have a cough.
sentences.zh: 我咳嗽。

sentences.en: I feel like I'm, like, getting a fever.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我好像要发烧了。

sentences.en: I mean, and she said, but I was tested negative for COVID, so can I just sit in the hallway?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，她说她做的新冠检测是阴性，所以她问能不能直接坐在走廊里？

sentences.en: So I brought her downstairs looking for the nurse, and I'm like, how can I send this student home?
sentences.zh: 所以我把她带楼下去找护士，当时我在想，我怎么才能让这个学生回家呢？

sentences.en: You know, we cannot have any students with any symptoms, regardless of, you know, positive or negative COVID tests.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，不管新冠检测是阳性还是阴性，我们都不能让任何有症状的学生留在学校。

sentences.en: So anyway, that's when I learned that we had no nurse because she was out with COVID, and that the principal assistant, because our principal's out with COVID,
sentences.zh: 总之，也就是在那时我得知我们没有校医护士，因为她感染新冠请假了；而且由于校长因感染新冠缺勤，校长助理

sentences.en: was now also doing the nurse job of, you know, communicating with students with symptoms and explaining, like, what the procedures and what they needed to do.
sentences.zh: 现在也得兼任校医的工作，比如与有症状的学生沟通，并解释相关的流程和他们需要做的事情。

sentences.en: And it's just been overwhelming.
sentences.zh: 这实在让人应接不暇。

sentences.en: Now to the battle over remote learning for Chicago public schools.
sentences.zh: 现在我们来看看关于芝加哥公立学校转为远程教学的争端。

sentences.en: As COVID cases climb, many teachers say they want out of the classroom and soon.
sentences.zh: 随着新冠确诊病例不断攀升，许多老师表示他们想离开教室，而且要快。

sentences.en: In fact, tomorrow, the teachers union is putting it to a vote.
sentences.zh: 事实上，明天教师工会就要进行投票表决。

sentences.en: That vote is expected tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 预计投票将在明天举行。

sentences.en: The Chicago teachers union expected to ask its members if they support staying out of the classroom and teaching remotely starting as soon as Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 芝加哥教师工会预计将询问其会员，是否支持从最早本周三开始离开教室并进行远程教学。

sentences.en: The Chicago teachers union electronically polling its 25,000 members to gauge interest in this potential return to remote learning.
sentences.zh: 芝加哥教师工会正以电子方式对其2.5万名会员进行民意调查，以衡量大家对这种可能恢复远程教学的意向。

sentences.en: The vote was done through our emails.
sentences.zh: 投票是通过我们的电子邮件进行的。

sentences.en: We were for remote learning or not.
sentences.zh: 看我们是否支持远程教学。

sentences.en: The union proposes remote learning to take effect unless the COVID surge subsides or testing and safety measures in schools are improved.
sentences.zh: 工会提议实施远程教学，除非新冠疫情消退，或者学校的检测和安全措施得到改善。

sentences.en: 73% of the teachers union voted in favor of moving instruction to remote learning.
sentences.zh: 73%的教师工会会员投票赞成将教学转为远程模式。

sentences.en: The vast majority of us said yes, that we wanted remote learning.
sentences.zh: 我们绝大多数人都投了赞成票，表示希望进行远程教学。

sentences.en: Tonight, city officials tried to persuade parents, students and teachers that schools are safe.
sentences.zh: 今晚，市政府官员试图说服家长、学生和教师，学校是安全的。

sentences.en: I'm urging teachers, come to school, teach your kids, your students need you.
sentences.zh: 我敦促老师们，来学校上课，教导你们的孩子，你们的学生需要你们。

sentences.en: Mayor Lightfoot says the lessons of 20 and 2021 show the dangers of remote learning outweigh the dangers of COVID for students.
sentences.zh: 莱特富特市长表示，2020年和2021年的经验教训表明，对学生而言，远程教学的危害超过了新冠病毒的危害。

sentences.en: And then the union finds out, we find out, everybody finds out that.
sentences.zh: 然后工会知道了，我们知道了，所有人都知道了。

sentences.en: Well, the rank and file members of the Chicago teachers union voted to temporarily switch to remote learning.
sentences.zh: 芝加哥教师工会的普通会员投票决定暂时转为远程教学。

sentences.en: Chicago public schools responding by canceling all classes, after school activities and sports for today.
sentences.zh: 芝加哥公立学校随即做出回应，取消了今天的所有课程、课外活动和体育运动。

sentences.en: We have city of Chicago and mayor of Lightfoot canceled classes.
sentences.zh: 芝加哥市政府和莱特富特市长取消了课程。

sentences.en: That was not our decision.
sentences.zh: 那不是我们的决定。

sentences.en: That's not what we wanted.
sentences.zh: 那不是我们想要的。

sentences.en: So we're just like stranded.
sentences.zh: 所以我们感觉就像被抛弃了一样。

sentences.en: Teachers and school administrators can't come to terms on resuming classroom instruction.
sentences.zh: 教师和学校管理者无法就恢复课堂教学达成一致。

sentences.en: The union calling conditions unsafe, demanding more testing and better masks.
sentences.zh: 工会称当前的条件不安全，要求进行更多检测并提供更好的口罩。

sentences.en: But the mayor accusing teachers of an illegal work stoppage.
sentences.zh: 但市长指责教师进行非法的罢工。

sentences.en: I will not allow them to take our children hostage.
sentences.zh: 我绝不允许他们把我们的孩子当成人质。

sentences.en: I will not allow them to compromise the future of this generation of CPS students.
sentences.zh: 我绝不允许他们危及这一代CPS学生的未来。

sentences.en: That is not going to happen.
sentences.zh: 这种事绝不会发生。

sentences.en: We've been failed by the mayor.
sentences.zh: 市长让我们失望了。

sentences.en: We've been failed by the public health office.
sentences.zh: 公共卫生办公室让我们失望了。

sentences.en: And teachers and other school staff have decided we have to, the only thing that we get control is whether we go into the buildings.
sentences.zh: 教师和其他学校员工已经决定，我们必须这么做，我们唯一能掌控的就是我们是否进入教学大楼。

sentences.en: It's very upsetting.
sentences.zh: 这让人非常沮丧。

sentences.en: You know, it's, you know, really just stupid is what it is.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，说白了，这简直就是愚蠢。

sentences.en: My name is Lilian Alfaro.
sentences.zh: 我叫莉莲·阿尔法罗。

sentences.en: I am a parent of a second grader, a fourth grader, a sixth grader, and an eighth grader.
sentences.zh: 我是四个孩子的家长，他们分别上二年级、四年级、六年级和八年级。

sentences.en: So how did you feel sending your kids off to school on Monday?
sentences.zh: 那么周一送孩子们去学校时你是什么心情？

sentences.en: So I felt okay sending them back to school, but there was only like five students in the classroom.
sentences.zh: 送他们返校时我觉得还可以，但教室里只有大约五个学生。

sentences.en: For that reason, my daughter's like, you know, nobody's coming to school.
sentences.zh: 正因为如此，我女儿说，你瞧，根本没人来上学。

sentences.en: Something is really wrong.
sentences.zh: 情况真的很不对劲。

sentences.en: And this is my eighth grader.
sentences.zh: 这是我上八年级的女儿说的。

sentences.en: So she said she kind of, you know, sat herself at a table, you know, closer to the corner where she was going to be alone.
sentences.zh: 所以她说她自己找了张桌子坐下，离角落近一点，这样她就能一个人呆着。

sentences.en: And she came home that day on Monday and she said, I don't feel safe.
sentences.zh: 那天周一她回家后说，我感觉不安全。

sentences.en: I don't want to go back.
sentences.zh: 我不想再去学校了。

sentences.en: She said, I know that there's a lot of my friends that are, you know, currently have COVID.
sentences.zh: 她说，我知道我的很多朋友目前都感染了新冠。

sentences.en: And it's just, it's scary.
sentences.zh: 这真的很让人害怕。

sentences.en: And are you vaccinated?
sentences.zh: 你们接种疫苗了吗？

sentences.en: Are your kids vaccinated?
sentences.zh: 你的孩子们接种疫苗了吗？

sentences.en: We are not vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 我们没有接种疫苗。

sentences.en: Not that I'm against vaccines, because they obviously had to get vaccinated in order to be in school since they were babies.
sentences.zh: 倒不是说我反对疫苗，因为他们从小为了上学显然必须接种过疫苗。

sentences.en: But I just, I have my different mixed emotions about the COVID vaccine.
sentences.zh: 但我只是对新冠疫苗有着各种复杂的情绪。

sentences.en: So I guess when the time comes, if it's going to be, you know, to the point where it's mandatory for them to have to go to school, then I guess we would have no other choice.
sentences.zh: 所以我想当时候到了，如果情况发展到他们去学校上学必须强制接种的地步，那我想我们就别无选择了。

sentences.en: But for now, I think we kind of just take the more natural route.
sentences.zh: 但目前，我想我们还是选择更自然的方式吧。

sentences.en: And thankfully, we have been okay.
sentences.zh: 谢天谢地，我们一直都挺好的。

sentences.en: My kids have not been sick.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子们没有生病。

sentences.en: Like, I have not been sick.
sentences.zh: 就像我也没有生病一样。

sentences.en: So then tell me about how you learn about school being closed.
sentences.zh: 那么跟我讲讲你是怎么知道学校要关闭的吧。

sentences.en: So I got an email from the school.
sentences.zh: 我收到了学校发来的电子邮件。

sentences.en: I, first of all, told my kids and they felt a sign of relief.
sentences.zh: 首先，我把这事告诉了我的孩子们，他们都如释重负地松了一口气。

sentences.en: And I completely understand because they're the ones that are in the school and have to experience, you know, what's going on.
sentences.zh: 我完全理解，因为他们是身处学校、必须亲身经历当前状况的人。

sentences.en: But my first thing was, what am I supposed to do to be able to go to work because I'm a single parent and I obviously have to work to support my kids.
sentences.zh: 但我的第一反应是，为了能去上班我该怎么办，因为我是个单亲妈妈，我显然必须工作来养活我的孩子。

sentences.en: But now it's just, you know, I'm overwhelmed all over again.
sentences.zh: 但现在，你知道的，我再次感到不知所措了。

sentences.en: It's just, it's hard.
sentences.zh: 生活太难了。

sentences.en: Check, check, check, check.
sentences.zh: 测试，测试，测试，测试。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So this is Rob Zipko.
sentences.zh: 我是罗布·齐普科。

sentences.en: I'm a producer on The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《每日播客》的制作人。

sentences.en: And I'm here in Chicago, Illinois.
sentences.zh: 我现在在伊利诺伊州芝加哥市。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, January 6th.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月6日，星期四。

sentences.en: It's the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 现在是下午。

sentences.en: Pretty clear, freezing winter day.
sentences.zh: 天气相当晴朗，是个滴水成冰的冬日。

sentences.en: And I'm in a quiet kind of residential neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 我在一个安静的住宅区里。

sentences.en: I'm walking over to the school here.
sentences.zh: 我正朝这边的学校走去。

sentences.en: So I'm going to see if anyone's here.
sentences.zh: 所以我要看看这里有没有人。

sentences.en: Excuse me.
sentences.zh: 打扰一下。

sentences.en: Would you guys have a minute?
sentences.zh: 二位能耽误一分钟吗？

sentences.en: I'm from The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 行啊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: Cool.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: Do you guys work at the school?
sentences.zh: 你们俩是在学校工作吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, we do.
sentences.zh: 对，我们是。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Would you mind telling me your name and what you do?
sentences.zh: 能告诉我你们的名字和职务吗？

sentences.en: I'm Kyle Vaninenum.
sentences.zh: 我是凯尔·范内宁姆。

sentences.en: I am a special education teacher at Rogers here.
sentences.zh: 我是这里罗杰斯学校的特殊教育老师。

sentences.en: Cool.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: What about you?
sentences.zh: 你呢？

sentences.en: I'm Chris Cormier.
sentences.zh: 我是克里斯·科米尔。

sentences.en: I'm a physical education teacher here at Rogers.
sentences.zh: 我是罗杰斯学校的体育老师。

sentences.en: So what do you kind of make of the current tension between the mayor and the union?
sentences.zh: 那么你对目前市长与工会之间的紧张关系怎么看？

sentences.en: It's frustrating.
sentences.zh: 这令人沮丧。

sentences.en: I'm a parent.
sentences.zh: 我是一位家长。

sentences.en: I've been a teacher for 21 years in CPS.
sentences.zh: 我在芝加哥公立学校当了21年老师。

sentences.en: So I understand.
sentences.zh: 所以我理解。

sentences.en: I do get both sides of it.
sentences.zh: 双方的立场我确实都能理解。

sentences.en: At the end of the day, everyone in this building wants to be back.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，这栋大楼里的每个人都希望回去。

sentences.en: We want students back in the building.
sentences.zh: 我们希望学生回到大楼里上课。

sentences.en: We want it to be in a safe way.
sentences.zh: 我们希望以安全的方式进行。

sentences.en: And it's scary.
sentences.zh: 这真的很吓人。

sentences.en: Like when you know, you know, this new strain, the Omicron strain, my son's already had it.
sentences.zh: 就像你知道的，这种新毒株，奥密克戎毒株，我儿子已经感染过了。

sentences.en: His entire baseball team has had it.
sentences.zh: 他整个棒球队都感染过。

sentences.en: I mean, everyone knows multiple, multiple people that are positive right now.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，每个人都认识好几个目前新冠检测呈阳性的人。

sentences.en: So it is scary.
sentences.zh: 所以这确实很吓人。

sentences.en: And I don't think, you know, I understand why the union needs to take a stand.
sentences.zh: 我不认为……我理解为什么工会需要表明立场。

sentences.en: And in order to get action done, we've had to be very aggressive with the steps that we take to get CPS to listen.
sentences.zh: 为了促成行动，我们不得不采取非常激进的步骤，来让芝加哥公立学校倾听我们的诉求。

sentences.en: And on the flip side, I get the frustration that parents feel like, oh my God, here we go again.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，我也能理解家长们感到的沮丧，比如“天哪，怎么又来这一出”。

sentences.en: When is this going to stop?
sentences.zh: 这到底什么时候才是个头？

sentences.en: So we want to get back in the building as soon as we can and do it in a way that we can all agree or at least come close to agreeing that we're doing it in a safe way.
sentences.zh: 所以我们希望尽快回到学校大楼里上课，并且以一种我们都能接受，或者至少接近达成共识的方式，确保我们在安全的环境下复课。

sentences.en: So you said you want to get back in the building.
sentences.zh: 所以你刚才说你想回到大楼里上课。

sentences.en: Did you vote to do remote on Tuesday night or did you vote to be in person?
sentences.zh: 你在周二晚上投票支持远程上课，还是投票支持线下上课？

sentences.en: I voted to be in person.
sentences.zh: 我投票支持线下上课。

sentences.en: And why did you vote for that?
sentences.zh: 那你为什么投这个票？

sentences.en: I've already been positive with the virus.
sentences.zh: 我之前已经感染过病毒了。

sentences.en: I got it at the beginning of the year and likely had the Delta strain.
sentences.zh: 我是在今年年初感染的，感染的可能德尔塔毒株。

sentences.en: My son, like he just had it the first week of break.
sentences.zh: 我的儿子也是，他刚在放假第一周感染过。

sentences.en: Likely it was the Omicron strain.
sentences.zh: 感染的可能是奥密克戎毒株。

sentences.en: So I guess the fear for me, I'm, I'm vaxxed, I'm boosted.
sentences.zh: 所以我想我倒是不怎么害怕，我已经接种过疫苗和加强针了。

sentences.en: So if I do get it, I know it's going to be pretty mild.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我真的再次感染，我知道症状也会比较轻微。

sentences.en: So that was my personal vote, my personal decision.
sentences.zh: 所以这是我的个人投票，我的个人决定。

sentences.en: Do I think we can continue to add measures to make it better and safer?
sentences.zh: 你觉得我们可以继续增加防疫措施，让情况变得更好、更安全吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: So I voted to be here in person, but I totally understand and respect, you know, my colleagues that voted the opposite.
sentences.zh: 所以我投票支持线下上课，但我完全理解并尊重那些投了反对票的同事们。

sentences.en: So did you also vote to be in person?
sentences.zh: 那你也是投票支持线下上课吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Like Kyle said, you know, I also got COVID back in 2020.
sentences.zh: 就像凯尔说的，我也在2020年感染过新冠。

sentences.en: I still went out, got fully vaccinated, just got my booster shot.
sentences.zh: 我后来还是去接种了完整疫苗，刚刚又打了加强针。

sentences.en: I feel great.
sentences.zh: 我感觉很好。

sentences.en: I'm ready to teach.
sentences.zh: 我已经准备好教书了。

sentences.en: I want to be here because people need to understand that educators were also frontline workers.
sentences.zh: 我想留在这里，因为人们需要明白，教育工作者也是一线工作人员。

sentences.en: We're here.
sentences.zh: 我们就在这里。

sentences.en: We're here to help the community.
sentences.zh: 我们来到这里是为了帮助社区。

sentences.en: So a lot of my decision was based on that.
sentences.zh: 所以我很大一部分决定都是基于这一点的。

sentences.en: And also timing, like I have two toddlers at home and I needed to help my wife.
sentences.zh: 还有时间安排，比如我在家里有两个幼儿，我需要帮我太太的忙。

sentences.en: And, you know, it puts us in a really awkward position when you're finding out, hey, there's no school tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 而且你知道的，当你突然发现“嘿，明天不用上学了”的时候，这种状况会把我们置于一个非常尴尬的境地。

sentences.en: And I also have a middle school age son.
sentences.zh: 我还有一个上初中的儿子。

sentences.en: And I've seen that remote learning doesn't work for him.
sentences.zh: 我发现远程学习对并不适合他。

sentences.en: He did much better with in-person instruction.
sentences.zh: 他在实体课堂里的学习效果要好得多。

sentences.en: He was failing his classes and he's a bright kid.
sentences.zh: 他以前成绩都在不及格边缘，但他其实是个聪明的孩子。

sentences.en: But when he's in-person and working with teachers like Kyle and all the people and resources that he has in the building, it's just a better environment for him.
sentences.zh: 但当他在线下上课，能和像凯尔这样的老师以及学校里的所有人、各种资源接触时，对他来说这就是一个更好的环境。

sentences.en: So what do you kind of see as like the trade-offs?
sentences.zh: 那你觉得这里面有什么权衡取舍吗？

sentences.en: What's the like kind of short term and the long term of the impact that this is having on teachers and on students?
sentences.zh: 这对老师和学生产生的短期和长期影响分别是什么？

sentences.en: Well, I think it's putting everybody in between a rock and a hard place.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得这把所有人都逼到了进退两难的境地。

sentences.en: You have one group that throws a rock and then the other group throws another rock.
sentences.zh: 有一方扔出一块石头，然后另一方又扔出一块石头。

sentences.en: And then parents are looking at, well, what's going on here?
sentences.zh: 然后家长们就在看，这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: You know, we have a bunch of rock throwing and these are supposed to be our leaders within our city and in our community.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们看到了一堆互相扔石头的人，而他们本该是我们城市和社区里的领导者。

sentences.en: And I think it just has to come down to thinking about what is the solution and getting to a solution.
sentences.zh: 我觉得事情最终还是要归结到思考解决方案并落实解决办法上来。

sentences.en: And in my opinion, I feel like you have to be vaccinated for measles, mumps, polio, everything else.
sentences.zh: 依我之见，我觉得接种麻疹、腮腺炎、小儿麻痹症以及其他所有疫苗都是强制要求的。

sentences.en: We need to add COVID to the list and we need to have it enforced.
sentences.zh: 我们需要把新冠疫苗也加进这份名单，并且必须严格执行。

sentences.en: In my opinion, you both said that your parents, what did you do for like child care the past couple of days?
sentences.zh: 依我来看，你们两个都提到了你们是父母，过去几天你们是怎么解决孩子看护问题的？

sentences.en: My wife is a nurse, so she works out in Lincolnshire.
sentences.zh: 我太太是一名护士，她在林肯郡工作。

sentences.en: So she works back to back 16 hour shifts on Saturday and Sunday.
sentences.zh: 所以她在周六和周日需要连续上两个16小时的班。

sentences.en: So she's home.
sentences.zh: 所以她在家。

sentences.en: I have two toddlers at home.
sentences.zh: 我家里有两个幼儿。

sentences.en: And what we decided to do for our community is we had a bunch of our friends call us, say, hey, you know, I don't want to get in trouble at work.
sentences.zh: 我们为社区做出的决定是，我们的一群朋友给我们打电话说，嘿，你知道的，我不想在工作上惹上麻烦。

sentences.en: I have to report to work.
sentences.zh: 我必须去上班。

sentences.en: So just me and my wife, we opened up our home.
sentences.zh: 所以我和我太太敞开了家门。

sentences.en: So I think she's watching like seven or eight kids today by herself.
sentences.zh: 所以我想她今天一个人在照看大概七八个孩子。

sentences.en: And, you know, she's awesome.
sentences.zh: 而且你知道的，她太棒了。

sentences.en: And we're unable at this.
sentences.zh: 我们现在无法做到这一点。

sentences.en: The answer is we can't take our kids into the building right now.
sentences.zh: 答案是，我们现在不能把孩子带进学校大楼里。

sentences.en: So, yeah, it's a difficult situation because I don't feel like the union 100% represents
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这是一个艰难的处境，因为我觉得工会并没有百分之百代表

sentences.en: every individual teacher.
sentences.zh: 每一位单独的老师。

sentences.en: And I feel the same about CPS.
sentences.zh: 我对芝加哥公立学校（CPS）也有同感。

sentences.en: So it's kind of that middle ground.
sentences.zh: 所以这就处于一种中间地带。

sentences.en: And it really it's it's an individual decision to, you know, stay home or to if they need to go into the building, that's their decision.
sentences.zh: 说到底，选择呆在家里，或者如果他们需要回学校大楼，这都是个人的决定。

sentences.en: And, you know, you got to respect their reasons.
sentences.zh: 而且你知道的，你必须尊重他们的理由。

sentences.en: You don't have to agree with it, but they have their reasons for doing it.
sentences.zh: 你不需要赞同，但他们有这么做的理由。

sentences.en: So it's just, you know, it's kind of getting comfortable with living in this new, you know, pandemic period that we're living through.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，这只是需要慢慢习惯生活在我们正在经历的这个新的大流行时期。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Stay warm, guys.
sentences.zh: 各位注意保暖。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app unlocked.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App现已解锁。

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month for free without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费体验《时报》一个月而无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》App时，你在该App中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》App，即可获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: For a third day, classes are canceled for Chicago's more than 300,000 public school students.
sentences.zh: 芝加哥30多万公立学校的学生连续第三天面临停课。

sentences.en: The latest Chicago Teachers Union proposal rejected in part tonight by Mayor Lori Lightfoot.
sentences.zh: 芝加哥教师工会提出的最新提案今晚遭到市长洛丽·莱特富特的部分拒绝。

sentences.en: You know the way teachers see that?
sentences.zh: 你知道老师们是怎么看的吗？

sentences.en: We see it as bullying.
sentences.zh: 我们认为这是霸凌。

sentences.en: We see this as an attempt to dictate all the terms and not listen to the people who are actually in there trying to make schools to make education work.
sentences.zh: 我们认为这是一种企图，想要一手包办所有条款，却不听取那些真正身处一线、努力让学校和教育运转起来的人的意见。

sentences.en: What I won't do is allow the Teachers Union to politicize this surge or the pandemic in general.
sentences.zh: 我绝对不会允许教师工会将这次疫情激增或整个大流行政治化。

sentences.en: People are nervous.
sentences.zh: 人们感到紧张。

sentences.en: They are scared.
sentences.zh: 他们感到害怕。

sentences.en: We get that.
sentences.zh: 我们理解这一点。

sentences.en: But the thing to do is to lean in to the facts and the science and not abandon them in a panic.
sentences.zh: 但应该做的做法是坚守事实和科学，而不是在恐慌中抛弃它们。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Hello?
sentences.zh: 喂？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Hi, this is Claire from The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是《纽约时报》的克莱尔。

sentences.en: How's it going?
sentences.zh: 最近怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm doing good.
sentences.zh: 我挺好的。

sentences.en: My name is Quinton Randall.
sentences.zh: 我叫昆顿·兰德尔。

sentences.en: Quinton?
sentences.zh: 昆顿？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Tell me some basics about yourself.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲你的一些基本情况吧。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I co-parent with my son's mother.
sentences.zh: 好的，我和我儿子的母亲共同抚养孩子。

sentences.en: My son is Quinton Randall as well.
sentences.zh: 我儿子也叫昆顿·兰德尔。

sentences.en: He attends McDade, which is a classical school, gifted school here in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 他就读于麦克戴德学校，那是芝加哥的一所古典学校和天才学校。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: He's a first grader.
sentences.zh: 他是一名一年级学生。

sentences.en: So, I mean, this closure is challenging and I just don't want these interruptions to really make him be like, okay, I could just stay home and I like this better now.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，这次停课很有挑战性，我只是不希望这些中断真的让他觉得“好吧，我可以一直待在家，我现在更喜欢这样”。

sentences.en: Like, we don't even really have a lesson plan to follow.
sentences.zh: 比如，我们甚至没有真正的课程计划可以遵循。

sentences.en: So, I've just kind of been having him do a little bit of everything just so he could, you know, stay in the mode of working.
sentences.zh: 所以，我只能让他每样都做一点，好让他能保持工作的状态。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, I'd love to get back to this moment, but I want to hear about the kind of trajectory of your son's education.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我很想回到这个话题，但我想听听你儿子教育轨迹的情况。

sentences.en: If he's in first grade now in 2022, he was just starting school when COVID hit, right?
sentences.zh: 如果他现在在2022年读一年级，那新冠疫情爆发时他才刚开始上学对吧？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, tell me about his 2020 school year firSt.
sentences.zh: 那么，先跟我讲讲他2020年的学年吧。

sentences.en: It was a lot.
sentences.zh: 那真是经历了很多。

sentences.en: You're literally telling a five, six-year-old kid to, hey, pay attention to a computer screen while he's maybe in a room with toys or a gaming system.
sentences.zh: 你简直是在对一个五六岁的孩子说，嘿，盯着电脑屏幕看，而他可能正身处一个摆满玩具或游戏机的房间里。

sentences.en: So, it's so easy to get distracted.
sentences.zh: 所以太容易分心了。

sentences.en: I mean, simple thing is, like, you're on a computer.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，很简单的事情，比如你在用电脑。

sentences.en: So, now you could go and play a game.
sentences.zh: 所以现在你随时可以去玩游戏。

sentences.en: Like, he was big into Roblox.
sentences.zh: 比如他非常迷Roblox（元宇宙游戏）。

sentences.en: One time, I was, he asked me a question about something about downloading.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他问了我一个关于下载的问题。

sentences.en: I knew it was, like, hey, I'm like, this has nothing to do with class.
sentences.zh: 我知道那是什么，我说，这跟课堂完全没关系。

sentences.en: Now, look, and he was downloading something new for Roblox.
sentences.zh: 结果一看，他正在为Roblox下载新东西。

sentences.en: And I'm like, no, this is not what you're supposed to be doing.
sentences.zh: 我说，不对，这不是你现在应该做的事情。

sentences.en: Well, he'd be like, dang, I finished the assignment already.
sentences.zh: 然后他会说，天哪，我已经把作业写完了。

sentences.en: So, now, like, it's like, oh, what do I tell you to do?
sentences.zh: 所以现在，这就变成了，我该叫你做什么呢？

sentences.en: You're actually done.
sentences.zh: 你其实已经做完了。

sentences.en: What are you supposed to be doing?
sentences.zh: 你接下来应该做什么？

sentences.en: I mean, you could either let your kid be done and just let them do whatever until the next assignment because they do have more breaks during e-learning.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你要么让孩子完成作业，然后让他们在下一个任务之前随便做点什么，因为他们在网课期间有更多的休息时间。

sentences.en: Or you can try to keep them busy.
sentences.zh: 或者你可以试着让他们保持忙碌。

sentences.en: And I prefer to keep them busy because I don't never, I never want to get them out of the mode of, this is how learning is.
sentences.zh: 我更倾向于让他们保持忙碌，因为我绝不希望让他们脱离“这就是学习应有的样子”这种状态。

sentences.en: Because once, once you get that break time, it's hard to snap a kid back and be like, hey, now it's time to learn again.
sentences.zh: 因为一旦你有了那些休息时间，就很难再把孩子的状态拉回来，对他们说，嘿，现在又是学习的时间了。

sentences.en: And it's just, like, it's a lot because I don't want any dips or anything in his foundation as far as education.
sentences.zh: 而且这真的很不容易，因为我不希望他在教育根基上有任何退步或闪失。

sentences.en: What do you mean by that?
sentences.zh: 你这话是什么意思？

sentences.en: It's like, he's in first grade, so, like, I know how big this time is and important it is for him as far as education goes.
sentences.zh: 就像是，他现在上一年级，所以我深知这段时间对他的教育有多么重大和重要。

sentences.en: But the fact that he was at home with the online learning is, like, even more pressure to make sure there's no slip-ups,
sentences.zh: 但他在家上网课这一事实，意味着更大的压力，必须确保没有任何滑坡，

sentences.en: no cracks in the foundation, to make sure that, basically, I'm doing my job to make sure my child doesn't fall.
sentences.zh: 确保根基没有裂缝，基本上就是我要尽到自己的职责，确保我的孩子不会掉队。

sentences.en: Because, I mean, that's how my mother did with me.
sentences.zh: 因为，我的意思是，我母亲当年对我也正是这样要求的。

sentences.en: I was, like, two or three years old, and she ordered her thonphonics, you know, for me.
sentences.zh: 我当时大概两三岁，她就为我订购了自然拼读教材。

sentences.en: So, I was learning to read, and my kindergarten teachers were exceptional.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时在学认字，而且我幼儿园的老师非常优秀。

sentences.en: I still remember them.
sentences.zh: 我至今仍记得他们。

sentences.en: My pre-K teacher, we're friends on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 我学前班的老师，我们现在还是Facebook的好友。

sentences.en: Like, so I had exceptional teachers.
sentences.zh: 所以说我遇到过非常优秀的老师。

sentences.en: Um, I remember my mom would hate, like, she would love and hate when it was book fair time because one of my big books, um, the Goosebumps series,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我记得我妈妈对书展到来时的心情可以说是又爱又恨，因为我当时很喜欢读那些大部头书，比如《鸡皮疙瘩》系列，

sentences.en: R.L.
sentences.zh: R.L.斯坦的书，所以我把整个《鸡皮疙瘩》系列都读完了。

sentences.en: Stine, so I was, like, reading through the whole Goosebumps series.
sentences.zh: 作者每出一本新书，我都想买一本。

sentences.en: Like, every time a book dropped, I wanted to get it.
sentences.zh: 所以这就变成了一种情况，她虽然很高兴，但天哪，你每次买这些书都在掏空我的钱包。

sentences.en: Like, it was one of those things, like, she's happy, but, man, you're running through my pockets every time with these books.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我以前是个狂热的读者。

sentences.en: So, like, I was, yeah, I was heavy, like, a heavy reader.
sentences.zh: 问很多问题，就像我儿子一样。

sentences.en: Asked a lot of questions, just like my son.
sentences.zh: 我以前就是那种学到一个新词就想在各种地方把它用上的孩子。

sentences.en: I was one of those kids that learned a new word and wanted to use it in every way possible.
sentences.zh: 所以，这一切都始于我母亲为我打下的基础。

sentences.en: So, like, but it all started from the foundation my mom laid.
sentences.zh: 因此，当你打好基础时，无论是教育、道德还是诸如此类的任何东西，它都会永远留在你的脑海深处。

sentences.en: So, like, when you lay a good foundation, whether it's education, morals, anything like that, it'll always be there in the back of your brain.
sentences.zh: 它不会消失。

sentences.en: It don't turn off.
sentences.zh: 她为我所做的一切，转化为了我为儿子所做的一切，因为从幼儿期到青春期前的这段时间至关重要。

sentences.en: What she did for me translated to what I do for my son because them first years up to the preteen years, those are important.
sentences.zh: 我经常这样说。

sentences.en: I say this a lot.
sentences.zh: 在芝加哥，你很难找到一个在内城长大的却没有以这样或那样的方式跟街头有所牵扯的人。

sentences.en: It's hard to find someone in Chicago who grew up in the inner city that's not, in some way or another, affiliated with the streets.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你总是会有空闲时间，但孩子的空闲时间太多了就会出问题。

sentences.en: I mean, you're going to always have idle time, but too much idle time is kids.
sentences.zh: 空闲时间太多了就容易让孩子们学坏。

sentences.en: You're a kid.
sentences.zh: 你还是个孩子。

sentences.en: You're curious.
sentences.zh: 你很好奇。

sentences.en: You might not even be bad.
sentences.zh: 你甚至可能并不坏。

sentences.en: You just want to see, hey, if I do this, what would happen?
sentences.zh: 你只是想看看，嘿，如果我这么做了，会发生什么？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: So, you just don't want them, one, you don't want them to get too used to this amount of free time, and then they get in school, and it'd be a problem.
sentences.zh: 所以，你就是不想让他们，第一，你不想让他们对这么多的空闲时间习以为常，然后他们去上学，这就成了个问题。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: So, that was my whole, me and his mom, whole thought process with e-learnings.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是我，我和他妈妈，关于网课的全部想法。

sentences.en: So, then how were you feeling over winter break as you saw Omicron hit the city of Chicago, and as you saw numbers rise in COVID cases?
sentences.zh: 那么，当你在寒假看到奥密克戎袭击芝加哥市，看到新冠病例数字上升时，你当时是什么感觉？

sentences.en: I thought it would be a possible, maybe, an e-learning situation, but to be in a situation now where there's no learning,
sentences.zh: 我以为可能会，也许会是上网课的情况，但是现在处于一种无学可上的状况，

sentences.en: well, that's not what I was expecting.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这可不是我所期待的。

sentences.en: I just feel like the kids are casualties in a war between, they're calling the politics, and they're the casualties of the war.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得孩子们成了他们所谓的政治博弈中的牺牲品，他们就是战争的牺牲品。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: I mean, I used to have a union job, so I'm very aware of what it means to be in a union, the good and the bad of the union,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我过去有一份工会工作，所以我很清楚身处工会意味着什么，工会的好与坏，

sentences.en: and I just wish that, you know, that the mayor could, that it could be some resolve.
sentences.zh: 我只是希望，你知道，市长能够，能有一个解决方案。

sentences.en: Like, it's not, I don't feel the urgency to resolve in these kids, especially in a city such as Chicago that does have violence, and kids, kids need to be in school, right?
sentences.zh: 就像是，我觉得这些孩子的事情没有那么迫切需要解决，特别是在芝加哥这样一个确实存在暴力的城市，孩子们，孩子们需要上学，对吧？

sentences.en: They need to be getting their education and learning and finding ways to not be, you know, with the song, uh, I don't mind, it's the playground for the devil.
sentences.zh: 他们需要接受教育、学习，并寻找方法不要，你知道的，就像那首歌里唱的，嗯，我不介意，这是魔鬼的游乐场。

sentences.en: Is that the song, though?
sentences.zh: 不过是那首歌吗？

sentences.en: I believe.
sentences.zh: 我相信是的。

sentences.en: I don't mind.
sentences.zh: 我不介意。

sentences.en: The I don't mind, I don't mind is the playground for the devil.
sentences.zh: “我不介意，我不介意”是魔鬼的游乐场。

sentences.en: You're having kids not doing anything.
sentences.zh: 你让孩子们无所事事。

sentences.en: Yeah, hello.
sentences.zh: 喂，你好。

sentences.en: Oh, hello.
sentences.zh: 哦，你好。

sentences.en: Hi, this is Addy.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是埃迪。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: My name is, uh, Atticus Patel.
sentences.zh: 我的名字是，呃，阿蒂库斯·帕特尔。

sentences.en: Uh, I am a junior in high school, and, and I live in the north side of Chicago.
sentences.zh: 呃，我是一名高二学生，而且，我住在芝加哥北部。

sentences.en: How do you think your classmates would describe you?
sentences.zh: 你觉得你的同学会怎么描述你？

sentences.en: My classmates would describe me as, uh, quiet, but I, uh, I would, I do get my work done.
sentences.zh: 我的同学们会把我描述为，呃，安静，但我，呃，我确实能完成我的作业。

sentences.en: When I got into high school, um, I didn't know anybody there, because I'd come from an elementary school where it was K through 8th, and I knowed everybody for nine years.
sentences.zh: 当我进入高中时，嗯，我在那里谁也不认识，因为我来自一所K到8年级的小学，九年来我都认识每一个人。

sentences.en: So going to high school was, like, a totally different experience, and I thought it was amazing.
sentences.zh: 所以去上高中就像是一次完全不同的体验，我觉得这太棒了。

sentences.en: You know, new people, the classes are very different.
sentences.zh: 你知道，新面孔，课程也很不一样。

sentences.en: I just, I really enjoyed it.
sentences.zh: 我只是，我真的很享受。

sentences.en: So going into, um, remote learning was really tough, because then I don't have, I didn't get to, I didn't get to see my friends anymore.
sentences.zh: 所以开始，嗯，远程学习真的很艰难，因为那样我就没有，我没能，我没能再见到我的朋友们。

sentences.en: I didn't get to have the experience of being in high school.
sentences.zh: 我没有体验到上高中的经历。

sentences.en: And waking up and, like, getting ready for the remote learning, I just feel very lazy, like, I don't want to do any of this.
sentences.zh: 而且醒来后，比如，为远程学习做准备，我感觉自己非常懒惰，就像，我不想做这一切。

sentences.en: I guess I can miss that assignment, and I guess I can miss that one.
sentences.zh: 我想我可以错过那个作业，我想我也可以错过那个。

sentences.en: Made me feel, like, a little, a little, a little hopeless.
sentences.zh: 让我感觉，有点，有点，有点绝望。

sentences.en: Like, you know, I guess we won't ever get back into, uh, in-person learning.
sentences.zh: 就像，你知道，我想我们永远不会回到，呃，线下上学了。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: How long total were you remote?
sentences.zh: 你远程上课总共多久？

sentences.en: Um, one and a half years.
sentences.zh: 嗯，一年半。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So then, how did you feel in September 2021, when you go back to school in person for the first time?
sentences.zh: 那么，在2021年9月，当你第一次重返学校进行线下上课时，你是什么感觉？

sentences.en: Oh, it was nerve-wracking.
sentences.zh: 哦，那真让人伤脑筋。

sentences.en: It was, it was, I was a little nervous, because I haven't seen my friends in a while.
sentences.zh: 那是，那是，我有点紧张，因为我有一段时间没见到我的朋友了。

sentences.en: I hadn't actually been in school, so I, I, I kind of forgotten, like, oh, I need to take a shower.
sentences.zh: 我实际上并没有在学校上学，所以，我，我，我有点忘了，哦，我需要洗个澡。

sentences.en: I need to get dressed.
sentences.zh: 我需要穿衣服。

sentences.en: I need to get ready for school.
sentences.zh: 我需要为上学做准备。

sentences.en: And, well, I got out of bed, you know, brushed my teeth, got ready.
sentences.zh: 然后，好吧，我起床了，你知道，刷了牙，准备好了。

sentences.en: I took a shower, and put on some new clothes, and I walked out the door with a backpack.
sentences.zh: 我洗了个澡，穿上新衣服，背着双肩包走出了门。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And, you know, I had to line up to get into the school, you know, go through the metal detector, and I hadn't done that in a while.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我得排队进学校，你知道，通过金属探测器，我已经好一阵子没做过这些了。

sentences.en: I was like, wow, this is really cool.
sentences.zh: 我就想，哇，这真的很酷。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And then I had to find my, my new classes, get to see some old teachers, some old friends.
sentences.zh: 然后我得找我的新教室，见到一些老老师，一些老朋友。

sentences.en: And, you know, I sat down for my first few classes, and I was like, wow, this is amazing.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我坐下来上了前几节课，我就想，哇，这太棒了。

sentences.en: I actually got to be in class.
sentences.zh: 我居然能来上课了。

sentences.en: You know, everybody was wearing a mask.
sentences.zh: 你知道，每个人都戴着口罩。

sentences.en: I couldn't see their face, but it was still, it was still amazing.
sentences.zh: 我看不到他们的脸，但它依然，它依然很棒。

sentences.en: And I, I got more motivated to do my homework, because now I'm actually in school, rather than on a computer.
sentences.zh: 而且我，我更有动力做作业了，因为我现在真的在学校里，而不是对着电脑。

sentences.en: I actually got to talk to some people, like, oh, what did you do for this question?
sentences.zh: 我实际上可以和别人说话，比如，哦，这道题你是怎么做的？

sentences.en: Oh, okay, thank you, you know.
sentences.zh: 哦，好的，谢谢你，你知道的。

sentences.en: So it was, it was, it was really comforting and really helpful to be back in school.
sentences.zh: 所以，回到学校真的让人感到欣慰，也真的很有帮助。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: You know, a lot of motivation, lots of less hopelessness.
sentences.zh: 你知道，动力十足，绝望感少了很多。

sentences.en: What have you been doing while you've been at home?
sentences.zh: 你在家的时候都在做些什么？

sentences.en: I've just been resting.
sentences.zh: 我一直在休息。

sentences.en: I, I'm kind of, you know, restless, because I'm so used to waking up early and going to school.
sentences.zh: 我，我有点，你知道，坐立不安，因为我太习惯早起去上学了。

sentences.en: I'm waiting, you know, like, what's going to happen next?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我在等，接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: Are we going to do remote learning?
sentences.zh: 我们要上网课吗？

sentences.en: Are we going to do in-class learning?
sentences.zh: 我们要去学校上课吗？

sentences.en: Good evening, a very big update tonight.
sentences.zh: 晚上好，今晚有一条非常重大的最新消息。

sentences.en: After days and days of negotiations, both sides finally have come to an agreement.
sentences.zh: 经过日复一日的谈判，双方终于达成了一项协议。

sentences.en: The teachers union did not get the remote learning it demanded, but its other desires were met with this new plan.
sentences.zh: 教师工会没有得到其要求的远程教学，但它的其他诉求通过这项新计划得到了满足。

sentences.en: This remote work action was about securing more safety for our school community and accountability that those safety measures would be there.
sentences.zh: 这次远程工作行动是为了确保我们的学校社区获得更多安全保障，并追究这些安全措施是否落实到位。

sentences.en: This set us back, but no obstacle is insurmountable.
sentences.zh: 这让我们遭受了挫折，但没有任何障碍是不可逾越的。

sentences.en: I'm, I'm convinced of that, but we've got to stay focused on what's most important, and that's our kids being in person.
sentences.zh: 我，我对此坚信不疑，但我们必须专注于最重要的事情，那就是让孩子们进行线下上课。

sentences.en: So moving forward, teachers will return to the classrooms across the district today, and classes will resume in person starting tomorrow morning.
sentences.zh: 因此，从今天开始，全区教师将重返教室，课程将于明天上午恢复线下进行。

sentences.en: Excuse me, do you have a minute?
sentences.zh: 打扰一下，您有一分钟时间吗？

sentences.en: Would you, would you mind if I asked your son a couple of questions?
sentences.zh: 您介意，您介意我问您儿子几个问题吗？

sentences.en: Go ahead.
sentences.zh: 请便。

sentences.en: How does it feel to be back at school today?
sentences.zh: 今天重返学校感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: Now, there are two feelings.
sentences.zh: 现在有两种感觉。

sentences.en: One, because we're back to school, there are some positive things, like being able to see your school friends.
sentences.zh: 第一，因为我们回到了学校，有一些积极的事情，比如能见到你的校友。

sentences.en: However, there's like, there's like, of course, this balance if you're in remote or if you're in in-person.
sentences.zh: 然而，这就像是，这就像是，当然，如果你上的是网课或是线下课，会有这样一种平衡。

sentences.en: So like, in-person, you have an easier time learning, and the work is much harder, but it's the direct opposite in remote.
sentences.zh: 所以就像，在线下，你学习起来更轻松，作业也难得多，但在网课中正好相反。

sentences.en: So, I sort of feel somewhat better in the school, but I'll just have to wait and see.
sentences.zh: 所以，我在学校里感觉稍微好一点，但我还得拭目以待。

sentences.en: What, uh, is there anything that you're like, worried about?
sentences.zh: 什么，呃，有什么让你担心的吗？

sentences.en: COVID numbers, yes, because, um, we have, because we, this is already like the third time we've went remote.
sentences.zh: 新冠病例数字，是的，因为，嗯，我们有，因为我们，这已经是我们第三次转为网课了。

sentences.en: So, um, yeah, so we never know, like, when the numbers are going to rise.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，是的，所以我们永远不知道数字什么时候会上升。

sentences.en: Like, you're kind of wondering, is there going to be another shutdown at some point?
sentences.zh: 就像，你难免会想，某个时候会不会又有关停？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What are you most looking forward to today?
sentences.zh: 你今天最期待的是什么？

sentences.en: Going back home.
sentences.zh: 回家。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Yes, going back home.
sentences.zh: 是的，回家。

sentences.en: Is there anything about the school day that you're looking forward to?
sentences.zh: 对于学校的一天，你有什么期待的吗？

sentences.en: And just, just hoping for the best that they give some fun school work.
sentences.zh: 只是，只是祈祷一切顺利，他们能布置一些有趣的学校作业。

sentences.en: How are you feeling today now that school's back open?
sentences.zh: 既然学校重新开学了，你今天感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: Honestly, I'm glad that it's back open.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我很高兴它重新开学了。

sentences.en: I work two jobs, and I'm glad that I'm able to go back to a normal schedule, drop my kid off, get ready for work.
sentences.zh: 我有两份工作，我很高兴能够回到正常的日程安排中，送孩子去上学，为上班做好准备。

sentences.en: So, it's a huge relief.
sentences.zh: 所以，这真是一个巨大的解脱。

sentences.en: Huge relief.
sentences.zh: 巨大的解脱。

sentences.en: I'm very relieved.
sentences.zh: 我感到非常释怀。

sentences.en: Kind of like I'm relieved.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像我松了一口气一样。

sentences.en: I'm happy about it.
sentences.zh: 我对此很高兴。

sentences.en: Going back to normal is something I think that everybody wants to have happen, so.
sentences.zh: 回到正常状态是每个人都希望发生的事情，所以。

sentences.en: Does it feel like normal today?
sentences.zh: 今天感觉像正常情况吗？

sentences.en: Is that how it feels?
sentences.zh: 感觉是这样的吗？

sentences.en: Well, the new normal.
sentences.zh: 嗯，新常态吧。

sentences.en: You dropped off some students here today?
sentences.zh: 你今天送了一些学生来这儿吗？

sentences.en: Dropped off my daughter just now.
sentences.zh: 刚刚送我女儿来。

sentences.en: And how did that feel?
sentences.zh: 那感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: Well, I'm a little anxious about it, you know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我对此有点焦虑，你知道的。

sentences.en: Anxious?
sentences.zh: 焦虑？

sentences.en: Like, what are you anxious about?
sentences.zh: 比如，你在焦虑什么？

sentences.en: Anxious about her contracting something, bringing it home, spreading it, and then that being spread to other people and all.
sentences.zh: 担心她感染了什么病毒，把它带回家，传播开来，然后传播给其他人等等。

sentences.en: By the time you get the results, God knows how many other people have been contaminated with that.
sentences.zh: 等你们拿到检测结果时，天知道还有多少其他人被传染了。

sentences.en: But yeah, I mean, still a concern.
sentences.zh: 不过是的，我的意思是，这仍然是一个令人担忧的问题。

sentences.en: But you just try your best to keep healthy, and we did all we can.
sentences.zh: 但你只能尽力保持健康，我们已经尽了我们所能。

sentences.en: And took our vaccinations, and just hope for the beSt.
sentences.zh: 并且接种了疫苗，只祈祷一切顺利。

sentences.en: Where do you think it'll go from here?
sentences.zh: 你觉得接下来会发展成什么样？

sentences.en: Oh gosh, I have no idea.
sentences.zh: 噢天哪，我毫无头绪。

sentences.en: I have no idea.
sentences.zh: 我毫无头绪。

sentences.en: You don't really feel like this issue has been, like, put to rest or anything?
sentences.zh: 你真的不觉得这个问题已经，怎么说，算平息了吗？

sentences.en: Oh, no.
sentences.zh: 哦，没有。

sentences.en: No, not at all.
sentences.zh: 不，一点也不。

sentences.en: No, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不。

sentences.en: So you're feeling pretty good that, like, school's going to stay open for the rest of the school year?
sentences.zh: 所以你觉得学校在剩下的学期里能一直开学，这让你感觉挺好的？

sentences.en: Honestly, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我不知道。

sentences.en: I'm uncertain about it, because they were so quick to just shut it down and then leave it closed for so many days.
sentences.zh: 我对此外出感到不确定，因为他们之前那么快就决定关停，然后一关就是好几天。

sentences.en: So I don't know.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道。

sentences.en: It's a big, it's a gamble right now.
sentences.zh: 这现在是一场豪赌。

sentences.en: But I hope so.
sentences.zh: 但我希望如此。

sentences.en: I hope so.
sentences.zh: 我希望如此。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, federal data showed that America's inflation problem is getting worse.
sentences.zh: 周三公布的联邦数据显示，美国的通货膨胀问题正在恶化。

sentences.en: Consumer prices rose 7% in December compared with a year ago, the fastest increase in four decades.
sentences.zh: 12月份消费者价格指数较上年同期上涨7%，创下四十年来最快涨幅。

sentences.en: The White House had predicted that inflation would quickly subside.
sentences.zh: 白宫曾预测通货膨胀会迅速消退。

sentences.en: But instead, the latest wave of the pandemic has further slowed the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但相反，新一波疫情进一步放缓了美国的

sentences.en: supply chain, created shortages, and as a result, kept prices high on everything from food to furniture.
sentences.zh: 供应链，造成了物资短缺，并因此导致从食品到家具等所有商品的价格保持高位。

sentences.en: And.
sentences.zh: 还有。

sentences.en: I think it's hard to process what's actually happening right now, which is most people are going to get COVID.
sentences.zh: 我认为很难去消化当前实际正在发生的事情，那就是大多数人都会感染新冠。

sentences.en: In testimony before the Senate, the head of the Food and Drug Administration, Janet Woodcock,
sentences.zh: 在参议院的听证会上，美国食品药品监督管理局局长珍妮特·伍德科克

sentences.en: predicted that most Americans will be infected by COVID-19 in the current phase of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 预测，大多数美国人在当前这一波疫情中都将被新冠病毒感染。

sentences.en: Woodcock said that recognizing that reality and planning for it is essential.
sentences.zh: 伍德科克表示，认清这一现实并为此做好规划至关重要。
